node.statement: For each graph point in (A_2), (R) gives ||D_{A^perp}f_V-I_calH||<=C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta_*)<=kappa_ch<=1/2<1. The Neumann-series criterion therefore makes D_{A^perp}f_V invertible. All remaining hypotheses of lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-atlas are exactly (A_2), so that external upgrades the same g_V and chi_V, without changing their points or first derivatives, to a C^infinity graph atlas defining a smooth embedded manifold structure on calU.
